thread:
Raj: FYI CobaltRx (COBALT-19) hit a budget alert for embeddings during onboarding. Need a short QBR-ready note + mitigation plan by tomorrow. :warning:
Kelly: saw it. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/clients/cobaltrx/spend daily tokens ~1.8M, projected monthly ~54M. Likely bulk import without dedupe.
Omar: quick fix we can push with low customer friction:
- enable embedding batching (batch_size=64)
- temporary throttle on ingest > 1.5M/day
- offer a 20-min enablement to run dedupe + chunking
Kelly: OpsBot posted: OpsBot: [budget-alert] COBALT-19 today_tokens=1,812,421 projected_month=54,372,630. Suggested actions: temp-throttle, notify FinOps.
Raj: For QBR slides we need 3 scenarios (tokens + $): mitigated (dedupe + batching + throttle), medium (batching + quant), baseline. One-line takeaway for slides please.
FinOpsBot: Acknowledged. Will return token->USD conversions and a sensitivity table (25/50/100% adoption) by EOD tomorrow.
Omar: SQL I run to split by route for the deck:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(cost_usd) as cost
FROM token_events
WHERE account_id='COBALT-19' AND ts >= '2026-03-01'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Kelly: I'll schedule the 20-min enablement and prep a 1-pager. Raj 1: can you add the three projection slides to the QBR deck and add an action to flip the budget rule if they consent?
Raj: yep. I'll add slides and create budget_rule/cobalt-temp-throttle-196777. Rule: throttle ingestion when daily tokens > 1,500,000.
OpsBot: [action_created] budget_rule/cobalt-temp-throttle-196777 created by Raj.
Kelly: Also ask the customer for permission to enable throttle. Draft note: "Hi CobaltRx 12 we detected a high-volume import. We can run a short session to implement batching and dedupe, and enable a temporary throttle until changes are live. Reply 'THROTTLE OK' to accept"
Raj: Thanks all. Capture any short customer feedback quotes during the session for the QBR renewal slide (docs gaps / friction). I'll tag renewal risk if they don't adopt within 7 days. :thumbsup:
